input.text:
tok 1.0 "Intake workflow"

pool institute "Mental health care institute"
  lane sec "Secretarial office"
    start notice "Notice by telephone received"
    task inquire "Inquire after name and residence of the patient"
    task putthrough "Put the doctor through to the nursing officer"
    task store "Store the form information in the information system"
    task print "Print the information"
    xor isnew "New patient?"
    task createfile "Create a patient file"
    xor newm
    task storeform "Store the registration form and print in the patient file"
    task cards "Produce two registration cards"
    task addlist "Add the patient to the list of new notices"
    task storeassign "Store the assignments in the information system"
    task passcards "Pass the registration cards to the first and second intaker"
    xor reqfile "Medical file required?"
    task letter "Prepare and send a letter requesting a copy of the medical file"
    task receivecopy "Receive the copy of the medical file"
    task informsecond "Inform the second intaker"
    task addcopy "Add the copy to the patient file"
    xor reqm
    and split
    task type "Type out the dictaphone tapes"
    task addinfo "Add the typed information to the patient file"
    and join
    task puton "Put the patient on the list of patients with both meetings done"
    task providelist "Provide the team-leader with the list of patients"
  lane nurse "Nursing officer"
    task fullinq "Make a full inquiry into the state of the patient"
    task record "Record the information on a registration form"
    task handin "Hand in the form at the secretarial office"
  lane lead "Team-leader"
    task assign "Assign new patients to a first and second intaker"
    task assignlist "Record the assignments on the assignment list"
    task determine "Determine whether the medical file is required"
    task handlist "Hand the assignment list to the secretarial office"
    task plan "Formulate the treatment plan"
    end done "Intake procedure ended"
  lane first "First intaker"
    task plan1 "Plan the meeting with the patient"
    task exam1 "Examine the patient using the standard checklist"
    task notes "Register additional observations in the notebook"
    task copynotes "Put a copy of the notes in the patient file"
    task addcheck "Add the checklist to the patient file"
  lane second "Second intaker"
    task plan2 "Plan the first meeting with the patient"
    task exam2 "Examine the patient"
    task dictate "Record observations on the dictaphone"

flow notice -> inquire -> putthrough -> fullinq -> record -> handin -> store -> print -> isnew
flow isnew -> createfile "yes"
flow isnew -> newm "no"
flow createfile -> storeform -> newm
flow newm -> cards -> addlist -> assign -> assignlist -> determine -> handlist -> storeassign -> passcards -> reqfile
flow reqfile -> letter "yes"
flow reqfile -> reqm "no"
flow letter -> receivecopy -> informsecond -> addcopy -> reqm
flow reqm -> split
flow split -> plan1
flow split -> plan2
flow plan1 -> exam1 -> notes -> copynotes -> addcheck -> join
flow plan2 -> exam2 -> dictate -> type -> addinfo -> join
flow join -> puton -> providelist -> plan -> done
